title: Security findings registry
description: Per-scope ledger of security findings. A security.json lives at the repo root or in a scope directory (any dir with an AGENTS.md; the gitignored local/ scope for findings that must not be tracked). It holds what is open or knowingly accepted — a fixed finding is removed. Written through scripts/security-findings.py; never holds a secret value.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema, for editor autocomplete and validation.

reviewed.description: Date of the last full review of what this registry covers.

id.description: Kebab-case, unique across every registry in the instance.

severity.description: high: exploitable as things stand — private data read, a person impersonated, data destroyed. medium: needs another failure first, or the damage is bounded. low: hygiene, no direct path to harm.

status.description: open: waiting for a fix. accepted: a risk knowingly kept, with a reason and a review date.

surface.description: Where: a host, a service, a file, a credential's name.

impact.description: What someone could do with it.

fixer.description: Who can carry the fix out: an agent in this repo, or a person acting on a system the agent does not hold.
